verdicts.reason: A keeps the product can, but the can is cropped at the top edge. The SUNSET SALE ribbon crowds the tiny SOLSTICE logo, the body copy and legal text are too small to read at 300x250, and the grey missing-asset placeholder sits on the legal line in the bottom-right corner. B drops the product can entirely, which is a major loss of fidelity. Its legal text is placed straight under the headline, ahead of the body copy, so the reading order is wrong. The badges and CTA are jammed into the bottom strip with the placeholder overlapping them, and the ribbon is crammed against the headline.
